## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] The project is directly related to AI presentations, PPTX editing, slide conversion, deck reconstruction, rendering, QA, or automation.
- [ ] GitHub repositories have at least 10 stars.
- [ ] The description is short, factual, and ends with a period.
- [ ] The entry is categorized by its primary workflow route, not merely by final export format.
- [ ] Tags, editability, and skill status are filled in when relevant.
- [ ] The category remains sorted by stars where practical.
- [ ] This pull request changes one project entry only.
- [ ] Bilingual update: `README.md` and `README_EN.md` were updated together when README content changed.
- [ ] 项目与 AI 演示、PPTX 编辑、幻灯片转换、deck 可编辑重建、渲染、QA 或自动化直接相关。
- [ ] GitHub 仓库至少有 10 stars。
- [ ] 描述简短、客观，并以句号结尾。
- [ ] 条目按主要工作流路线分类，而不是仅按最终导出格式分类。
- [ ] 已按需填写标签、可编辑性和 Skill 状态。
- [ ] 分类内仍尽量按星标排序。
- [ ] 本 PR 只修改一个项目条目。
- [ ] 中英文同步：修改 README 内容时，`README.md` 和 `README_EN.md` 已同步更新。
